text: Class names and data attributes added in 22656c4. GrobMeta carries an optional CssClass and an insertion-ordered Vector[(DataKey, String)], emitted by the SVG backend as class and data-* attributes on the wrapping group and ignored by the raster backends. CssClass accepts one or more whitespace-separated ASCII identifier tokens (-?[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_-]*) and normalises them to single-space separation, so equality is token equality; DataKey accepts [a-z][a-z0-9-]* and refuses the reserved suffix 'name', because data-name is every backend's channel for a grob's GraphicsName. Both are checked constructors returning Either[GraphicsError, _]; Grob.annotated itself is total. Acceptance met: class and data attributes appear on the emitted group and absent ones change nothing (SvgAnnotationSuite pins the full-metadata, title-only, class-only and empty documents exactly); attribute-name validation refuses whitespace-bearing class tokens and non-data-safe keys (GrobMetaSuite); a repeated data key is a typed SvgRenderError.DuplicateDataKey rather than a duplicate attribute; geometry is unchanged by styling, pinned by the conformance 'annotated' case and by SceneLayoutLawsSuite, which also proves the wrapper contributes no name. storyatlas4s reports that origin-as-shape and kind-as-class compose as intended and that class/data-* rules are enough for its host theme. Not established: the optional paint mode emitting var(--token, #rrggbb) for a named Rgba is NOT implemented, so a host theme reaches the plate through class and data-* rules rather than through intaglio-substituted colour tokens; storyatlas4s confirmed it does not need the token form.
